description: Issue #10: fuzzer seed 73. Extrude an arc-sided profile, fillet two top edges, then join a box. The join's boolean union is refused by solidcore's boolean check as "Bad Gap: Edge/Vertex gap across Edgeuse start larger than tol" (offset=7.7878382e-06, tolerance=7.5978919e-06). Every failing seed of the boolean fuzzer is a reproducible bug, fixed with a regression test that fails without the fix.
